svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 330 mm of 40 x 5 mm flat bar. Bend 90 degrees in the vice to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: an L, measured outside the bend: a 132 mm upright leg on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wall and a 200 mm arm standing out from it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: two 6.6 mm holes on the centre line, 25 and 80 mm up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from its bottom end, for M6 screws with wall plugs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm: two 5.5 mm holes on the bar's centre line, 152 and 188 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: out from the wall face (36 mm apart), for the valve screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Match these two holes to the tapped holes under the valve you buy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: arm level, 1,272 mm above the floor; valve on top on two M5

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws from below. The gas fitter connects the valve ports.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the arm is level and does not flex when the valve is pushed.
